user.title: Hisense E7N Pro
user.description: The TV must be on for pairing. Default broker port is 36669 (VIDAA MQTT over TLS). Aijia cannot wake a fully off TV — pick a button device that actually powers it on.

data_description.host: IPv4 of the E7N Pro. Give it a DHCP reservation.
data_description.power_on_button: Home Assistant button / switch / script that physically turns the TV on (IR blaster key, smart plug, helper button). Turn-on calls button.press (or switch.turn_on). MQTT KEY_POWER cannot start a dead TV.
data_description.mac: Optional. Used for the device registry and as a Wake-on-LAN fallback if no button is set.
data_description.auth_mode: auto tries modern VIDAA credentials first, then legacy static login.
data_description.client_cert: Leave empty to use a generated stand-in cert. If MQTT rc=5, extract the VIDAA/爱家 client cert (see docs).

pin.title: Pair with the TV
pin.description:
If the TV shows a 4-digit PIN, enter it. If nothing appeared, the UUID is already authorized — leave the field empty and submit.

Hint: {hint}

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the TV MQTT broker on port 36669. Confirm the TV is on, the IP is correct, and phone remote control is enabled.
error.invalid_pin: The PIN was not accepted. Try again before the on-screen dialog times out.

abort.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the TV.

data_description.power_on_button: Entity pressed when the TV is off. Aijia cannot power the TV on by itself.

send_key.name: Send remote key
send_key.description: Send a VIDAA / 爱家 KEY_* code to the TV.

key.name: Key
key.description: Wire name (KEY_HOME) or alias (home, ok, mute).

launch_app.name: Launch app
launch_app.description: Launch an installed VIDAA app by name.

url.name: App URL / id
url.description: Optional store url such as netflix.
